profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Stitch Fix
profile.summary:
I’m a fullstack lead engineer with 8 years of experience. I'm passionate about building impactful and scalable technology. My job is most rewarding when working alongside a collaborative and fun team!

Other interests:  Cats. Cooking.

Email: dclorena11@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Took on a project of reworking legacy code to make workers more scalable for company growth
Converted internal applications from using Rails views to Reactjs
Maintained API for new/old React apps
Build backend architecture for operations applications
Help unblock and mentor team members

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack development for Operations Tech
Took on lead role for several projects designing architecture for new applications
Contributed to refactor of legacy code
Onboarded new hires

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to feature work on several Rails projects
Carried out site-wide redesign for e-commerce shop

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a number of Rails projects for different industries
Worked on RESTful API
Automated iPhone/Android screenshot generation using fastlane.tools
Implemented client-side javascript libraries (DHX Gantt chart, Reactjs, calendars and datepickers)

volunteerExperiences.description: Code Platoon is a coding bootcamp for veterans looking for a new career in tech. I served as a rubber duck/sounding board to students learning Python and React after teaching hours.
